name: ML001 Defensive-Cap + True-Shooting Confirmation
interpretation: A strong recent net-rating edge with meaningful rest advantage, excluding defense-dominant profiles that historically produced more ML001 losses, and requiring the edge to be confirmed by a material five-game true-shooting advantage.

robustness.ts5_neighborhood_note: Thresholds from 0.05 through 0.06 remain high-hit and positive-ROI; the discovery-selected threshold is retained frozen rather than retuned.

notes: This is a higher-selectivity descendant of NBA_ML001_DEF, not an independent family.
The method passed internal confirmation, validation, holdout, worst-price, leave-one-season-out and COVID-exclusion checks.
Any future live consideration requires prospective 2026-27 performance under the frozen rule.
